text:
zara: Opening thread for the docs relnotes + migration sweep. Targets: migration guide v0.9→v1.0, unified streaming snippets, and a Known Issues blurb for embed streaming fallback. Looking to publish Friday midday.

jay: I can do a pass on the SDK examples. Found JS snippet mismatch in PR #4310. Will link tests.

miguel: I'll update the curl examples in the migration guide and fix endpoint naming — saw /v1/generate still referenced. Will run anchor-check after.

elaine: I ran a quick local build and anchor-check. Command I used:
```
make site && ./scripts/anchor-check --output broken-anchors.txt
```
Result excerpt:
- docs/guides/migration.md: missing anchor #private-deploy (x3)
- docs/snippets/streaming.md: example-id:stream-py mismatch

docs-bot: CI: docs-linkcheck kicked on PR #4310. Status: failed (anchors + snippet-tests).

sam: The private-deploy anchor got renamed when we moved the rollout content. I'll add a frontmatter redirect in migration.md to preserve inbound links and push as a tiny patch.

jay: Proposed canonical snippet naming: use `client.generate_stream()` across py/js in docs, and add a compatibility note: "Older SDKs may expose streaming helpers under `client.stream.*`. See compatibility section." Pushed draft in PR #4311 (branch: docs/snippets-unify).

miguel: For the cURL example, new response is chunked json lines. I'll include jq example to show how to parse tokens: 
```bash
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"kestrel-1","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams | jq -c 'select(.type=="token") | .data.text'
```
This will help customers migrating from the old single-response flow.

zara: Good. We also need a short Known Issues blurb that is clear for product folks: "If embed streaming falls back to polling, tokens may be delayed up to ~2s and order-of-arrival may be different; the system will retry streaming automatically when capacity returns." Keep it non-technical.

elaine: After sam's redirect patch, re-run CI please. I can re-run anchor-check on the PR branch.

sam: Redirect frontmatter added in PR #4312 (docs: migration redirect for private-deploy). Small change.

docs-bot: CI update: PR #4312 lint OK; docs-linkcheck next.

jay: Snippet-tests still failing on PR #4311 — failing test shows python runner expecting `stream.generate()` not `generate_stream()`. I can add a compatibility note to the test harness but prefer docs align to new API.

miguel: If test harness breaks older CI images, let's add a note in relnotes: "Docs snippets assume SDK >=0.9.1; projects using older SDKs should see compatibility notes." I'll draft that line.

zara: We're adding three items to relnotes: 1) migration guide update + curl + jq example, 2) snippet standardization + compatibility callout, 3) Known Issues for embed streaming fallback. Drafting now and will paste a short summary for copy editing.

elaine: FYI I also found a broken internal link in the rollout checklist referencing `#deployment-rollout` — adding that to broken-anchors.

sam: I'll add frontmatter redirects for both `#deployment-rollout` -> `#private-deploy-rollout` and `#private-deploy` -> `#private-deploy` (preserve casing). Pushing patch now.

docs-bot: All PRs status summary: #4310 (streaming-update): failing links; #4311 (snippets-unify): snippet-tests failing; #4312 (redirects): lint OK.

jay: I'll re-run snippet unit locally with py runner v0.9.2. If it fails, I'll update the test expectations and leave a note in the relnotes.

miguel: One more ask: can someone sanity-check the migration guide's section on tokens-per-request? We changed default batching behavior and it affects example costs.

zara: @miguel please update that paragraph and add a short cost-note: "Default batching reduces per-token cost in high-throughput scenarios; single-request dev examples will not see automatic batching."

sam: Redirects merged; CI green on #4312.

docs-bot: PR #4310 updated: docs-linkcheck now reports only 1 anchor (streaming example id).

jay: Fixed snippet lint in #4311 and updated tests to expect `generate_stream`; pushed. Snippet-tests are now passing locally.

docs-bot: PR #4311 CI: lint OK, snippet-tests OK, linkcheck pending.

zara: Great work. Timeline reminder: final review Thursday EOD, publish Friday at 12:00 PT. I'll post the relnotes draft for final copy-edit in this thread tomorrow AM. :sparkles:
